name: Cloud Browser Workspace
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if [ -f browser-profile.tar.gz ]; then docker run --rm -v chromium_data:/config -v "$(pwd)":/backup lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest tar -xzf /backup/browser-profile.tar.gz -C /config; fi; docker start chromium 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name=chromium -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -e CHROME_CLI="--num-raster-threads=2 --enable-zero-copy --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled --user-agent=\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36\" https://discord.com/app https://www.instagram.com https://www.tiktok.com" -p 3000:3000 -p 3001:3001 -v chromium_data:/config --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size="2gb" --restart unless-stopped lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest'
